about: The sources Help lists, in order, as README.md section 10 and references.bib give them: each a citation and the address it links to. Data, not words: the same in every language, so it is in no catalogue, and it is not reviewed as copy. The web bundles it (src/ui/sources.ts) and iOS has it as a bundle resource (ios/project.yml, HelpView.swift). Curly quotes, as in the catalogues (copy.test.ts 3c).

sources.text: C. D. H. Williams, “The Science of Boiling an Egg”, University of Exeter (1998). newton.ex.ac.uk/teaching/CDHW/egg (the host is gone; the page is in the Internet Archive)

B. Abbasnezhad, N. Hamdami, J.-Y. Monteau and H. Vatankhah, “Numerical modeling of heat transfer and pasteurizing value during thermal processing of intact egg”, Food Science & Nutrition 4, 42-49 (2016). doi:10.1002/fsn3.257

S. Denys, J. G. Pieters and K. Dewettinck, “Computational fluid dynamics analysis of combined conductive and convective heat transfer in model eggs”, Journal of Food Engineering 63, 281-290 (2004). doi:10.1016/j.jfoodeng.2003.06.002
